safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient specifically tried E45 and antihistamines (with minimal relief) reduces accuracy of prior-treatment history and could lead to redundant recommendations or missing a clue about itch management. This is unlikely to directly cause harm but may delay effective symptom control.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to clearly document NKDA (instead using vague wording) degrades medication-safety documentation and may prompt unnecessary re-checking or uncertainty when prescribing.
